report: MEWDS is the leading diagnosis. A 26-year-old myopic woman had acute unilateral vision loss and metamorphopsia. Fundoscopy showed posterior-pole yellow-white spots with a quiet anterior chamber/vitreous. SD-OCT found focal ellipsoid zone elevation, hyperreflective material, and intact RPE/Bruch's membrane; OCTA excluded choroidal neovascularization. These support MEWDS and refute myopic degeneration, uveitis, and MFC/PIC. Confirmatory tests pending; MEWDS favored, not confirmed.
